metadata.purpose: Open live multicast windows from an opening signal and close each from its own selector-created signal.

conditions: No initial window; each successful opening reaction announces one handle.
Source values go to every currently open window; opening and closing payloads are control inputs.
Closing next closes its own window; closing complete only disconnects that signal.
Source/closing/selector failure errors current windows; opening failure disposes them silently.

scope.parameters: Valid Observable opening signal; synchronous closingSelector returns a valid Observable. Fresh safe-integer window generations.
scope.callbacks: Selector invocation carries the exact opening payload. Correlated return/throw is supplied synchronously; the model never executes user code.
scope.time: No clock or timer. Sources supply time; input order resolves equal-time events. runWindowToggleTrace enforces selector outcome at invocation envelope time.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Setup-time synchronous opening/source/closing emissions and arbitrary callback/observer reentrancy.
Foreign ObservableInput conversions, invalid closing-selector returns, direct Subject mutation and non-safe generation overflow.
Late subscription to disposed handles throws synchronously and is characterized natively outside the legal model event alphabet.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire opening signal, then source; assume neither acquisition emits before setup returns. No initial window is emitted.

ownership.sharing: Each outer connection owns its opening/source/closing subscriptions. Each window multicasts live values without replay; children hold no upstream lease.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

resources.owner: outer execution; one generation per window
opening reaction; correlated by window generation

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.

Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Opening signal carries the selector input.

Identified closing signal completes without closing its window.
One closing signal fails all live windows and the result.
Independent consumer attaches to an announced usable window.
Independent consumer closes its own connection.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: subscribe source; emit no initial window
rules.nextState: Active, no windows or consumers; opening signal is live.
rules.explanation: Openings are acquired before source. Construction is inert; only opening next can request a window.

rules.guard: opening signal is live and next identity can advance safely
actions: invoke closingSelector with exact opening payload
rules.nextState: Selecting with one pending window identity; no handle has been emitted for it.
rules.explanation: The implementation creates its Subject before calling the selector, but announces it only after successful conversion.

rules.guard: matching synchronous selector returns a valid Observable
rules.nextState: Pending window becomes open, announced and attached to its uniquely identified closing subscription.
rules.explanation: The outcome abstracts the valid Observable result; its subscription occurrence is identified by the window generation.

actions: release opening, source and live closings
rules.nextState: Stopped with retained errored handles; failed pending window was never announced.
rules.explanation: The private new Subject is failed too, but no public observer can attach to that unannounced identity.

rules.guard: source is connected between atomic reactions
actions: send the same value to each open window consumer in window creation and observer attachment order
rules.nextState: All window and closing state remains unchanged.
rules.explanation: No current windows means the source value is dropped. Windows multicast live values without replay or buffering.

rules.nextState: Window retains completion; other windows, source and opening signal are unchanged.
rules.explanation: A closing value is a control signal; it is not forwarded as a source value.

rules.nextState: Window stays open without a live closing signal.
rules.explanation: RxJS 7.8.2 installs noop for closing completion. Empty completion does not close a window.

rules.nextState: No more windows can open; source and current windows continue.
rules.explanation: Opening completion is not output completion and does not implicitly close any current window.

actions: error every open window consumer before outer error
release opening, source and remaining closings
rules.nextState: Stopped; failed windows retain their exact error for late observers; completed windows remain completed.
rules.explanation: Source and closing errors use handleError, which drains the window array before source finalization.

actions: error every open window consumer before outer error
release opening, source and remaining closings
rules.nextState: Stopped; failed windows retain their exact error for late observers; completed windows remain completed.
rules.explanation: Source and closing errors use handleError, which drains the window array before source finalization.

actions: complete all open window consumers before outer completion
release opening, source and live closings
rules.nextState: Stopped; every announced window retains completion and can complete late consumers.
rules.explanation: The implementation removes each Subject from its active array before completing the outer result.

actions: release opening, source and live closings; dispose current Subjects silently
rules.nextState: Stopped; current handles are disposed and existing child subscriptions remain orphaned.
rules.explanation: Opening errors use the default subscriber path, not handleError. Current window consumers receive no error or complete.

actions: release opening, source and live closings; dispose current Subjects silently
rules.nextState: Stopped; attached child Subscriptions remain independently closeable and current handles reject late subscription.
rules.explanation: Subject.unsubscribe is not Subject.complete. Historical completed windows are not disposed.

rules.guard: fresh observer names an announced open window
actions: acquire one child observer connection without replay
rules.nextState: Consumer is attached; no upstream lease is added.
rules.explanation: Window consumers share values only inside this outer execution; they do not own the source connection.

rules.guard: fresh observer names an announced complete window
actions: deliver retained terminal notification without value replay
rules.nextState: No consumer remains attached; the historical handle retains its terminal state.
rules.explanation: Only announced handles are addressable; a selector failure never exposes its private pending window.

rules.guard: addressed child observer still owns a subscription
rules.nextState: Other children and upstream resources are unchanged.
rules.explanation: Orphaned consumers after disposal remain independently owned.

rules.explanation: Only announced handles are addressable; a selector failure never exposes its private pending window.

rules.explanation: Only announced handles are addressable; a selector failure never exposes its private pending window.
